description: The Open/Close Sensor and the Leak Sensor, whose Developer Notes give the same configuration byte and extended settings.

readings.name: databaseDelta

values.name: ledBrightness
values.label: LED brightness
values.description: The LED's brightness, from 0x00 to 0xFF (brightest). It's 0x64 by default.

values.name: configuration
values.label: Configuration
values.description: The configuration byte, which Get Operating Flags with cmd2 0x00 also reads.

writes.name: stayAwake
writes.description: Keeps the sensor awake for the number of seconds in D3.

extendedCommands.name: readSettings
extendedCommands.description: Reads the LED's brightness and the configuration byte.

notes: The sensors sleep to save their batteries, and hear commands only while awake.
Direct commands from a device that isn't in the sensor's ALL-Link database get a NAK with 0xFF in cmd2.
The Open/Close Sensor's configuration byte is 0x43 by default, and the Leak Sensor's is 0x4F.
The guides give D4 and D5 of the extended Get reply as 0x01 and 0x23 without saying what they hold.
The guides document no Set Operating Flags commands for these sensors. Write the configuration byte with an extended Set instead.
